user.title: Connect to your Norman hub
user.description: Enter the host/IP of your Norman hub. Password defaults to the factory value unless you changed it.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with your Norman hub
reauth_confirm.description: The hub at {host} rejected the login. If you haven't changed the password, the hub itself may be stuck: power-cycle it, then submit the same password again.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Norman hub

init.title: Norman Blinds options
init.description: The position the room Favorite buttons record. A Favorite press sends the hub's own Favorite (each blind goes to the favourite stored in its motor), then about 20 seconds later records this position so HA shows where the blinds are. Set it to match your favourite in the Norman app, or blinds that respond to room position commands will move to this value instead.
